title: Duplicating a `Script` in an exported build removes its implementation
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9159) - AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 w/ Radeon 890M (24 threads) - 15.11 GiB memory

### Issue description

(A user named Variant on Discord came across this issue [here](https://discord.com/channels/1235157165589794909/1461631532727799818/1461631532727799818). I did some testing to figure out what the issue is _exactly_.)

When a `Script` is duplicated (using `Resource.duplicate()`) in an editor build, everything seems to work as expected. However, when exporting the build, its base type (`Script.get_instance_base_type()`) is reset to `RefCounted`, and all its methods are gone. See the following code as an example:
```gdscript
extends Node2D

func _ready() -> void:
    print("Normal script type: ", get_script().get_instance_base_type()) # always prints Node2D as expected

    var script: Script = get_script().duplicate()
    print("Duplicated script type: ", script.get_instance_base_type()) # prints Node2D on editor build, but RefCounted on exported build

    var inst: Object = script.new()
    print("Duplicated script instance class: ", inst.get_class()) # prints Node2D on editor build, but RefCounted on exported build

    print("Normal script methods: ", get_script().get_script_method_list()) # always prints the expected list of methods
    print("Duplicated script methods: ", script.get_script_method_list()) # works normally on editor build, prints an empty array on exported build
```

~As Variant told me their issue is Windows-only, this may be Windows-specific. I cannot verify that myself though, as I only have a Windows machine. It does not matter if the project is exported as a debug or a release build.~

EDIT: It turns out that the issue be not be Windows-only after all, I guess it only came up when testing on Windows machines. I still cannot confirm this one way or another though.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the MRP below
2. Run the project from the editor - everything works as expected
3. Export the project
4. Run the exported build - does not work as expected

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24687208/mrp.zip)
